title: Island Defect Configuration Schema
description: An island defect configuration where a void region is created in a slab, leaving an island of material.

items.title: Slab Configuration Schema
items.description: A slab unit cell consisting of repeated unique atomic layers and vacuum.

items.title: Atomic Layers Unique Repeated Schema
items.description: Atomic layers unique with an integer number of repetitions, forming a full periodic structure with top layer specified by the termination

termination_top.title: Termination Schema
termination_top.description: Defines a specific termination of a slab

chemical_elements.title: Chemical Elements
chemical_elements.description: Chemical elements at the termination. Can be a single element (e.g. 'Si') or a compound (e.g. 'SiO')

anyOf.description: A string representing a stoichiometric formula for surface atoms of a plane, e.g. 'SrTiO', 'SrO', 'O2' or 'Hf2O'

space_group_symmetry_label.title: Space Group Symmetry Label

number_of_repetitions.description: Number of repetitions of the unique atomic layers

miller_indices.description: Miller indices [h, k, l] defining crystallographic planes

message.description: Message generated by the consistency check describing the problem.

type.description: If assume_isolated = 'esm', determines the boundary conditions used for either side of the slab.
